entities.summary: Nigel Bradham is an American former professional football player who was a linebacker in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida State Seminoles. He was selected by the Buffalo Bills in the fourth round of the 2012 NFL draft, and played for the Philadelphia Eagles from 2016 to 2019.
